description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Zack)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Zack)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Zack)], removes [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Zack)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Zack)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Wind abilities, casts Dual Tornado Descent after using Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Tornado Descent
description.text: Causes [Imperil Wind 10% (5s)], grants [Critical Damage +50% 1] to all allies

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
